fields.climate:
Saint Helena: tropical marine; mild, tempered by trade winds
Ascension Island: tropical marine; mild, semi-arid
Tristan da Cunha: temperate marine; mild, tempered by trade winds (tends to be cooler than Saint Helena)
fields.terrain:
the islands of this group are of volcanic origin associated with the Atlantic Mid-Ocean Ridge
Saint Helena: rugged, volcanic…
fields.hazards: active volcanism; volcanism: the volcanoes of Tristan da Cunha (2,060 m) and Nightingale Island (365 m) are active
fields.farm: coffee, corn, potatoes, vegetables; fish, lobster; livestock; timber
fields.exports: fish, shellfish, natural gas, trucks, construction vehicles
fields.industries: construction, crafts (furniture, lacework, fancy woodwork), fishing, collectible postage stamps
fields.religions: Anglican 63.2%, unspecified 11.4%, no religion 9%, Jehovah's Witness 3.8%, Baptist 2.3%, Salvation Army 2%, Roman Catholic 2.2%, Seventh Day Adventist 1.9%, New Apostolic 1.6%, other Christian 1.4%…
